==Biography==
On January 4, 2015, [[EDward Gaming]] announced the departure of NaMei.<ref>[http://t.qq.com/p/t/445914017527396 Edward Gaming's Tencent Weibo Post (Chinese)] ''t.qq.com''</ref> He joined [[SHRC]], but was not allowed to play in the LPL until his contract with EDG would have expired naturally, since the transfer was not made during the allowed period.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''NaMei''' is short for his Chinese ID "'''那逼很美'''" (Na Bi Hen Mei).
* Reached 1000 Kills in the LPL in April, 2016.
** The 4th player to reach 1000 Kills in the LPL, after [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[Cool]], and [[Kid]].
